RESEARCH FILE // CHAOS-04

CHAOS THEORY & NUMERICAL INTEGRATION

Nonlinear Dynamics Research

Computational physics research on driven, damped pendulum systems with emphasis on numerical methods, phase-space behavior, and the transition to chaos.

ARCHIVE IMAGE // REPRESENTATIVE PHASE-SPACE OUTPUT
RESEARCH METHODS
EULER-CROMER / RK2 / RK4 / VELOCITY VERLET
  • Developed Python simulations of driven, damped nonlinear pendulum systems to investigate sensitivity to parameters and initial conditions.
  • Compared Euler-Cromer, second-order Runge-Kutta, fourth-order Runge-Kutta, and Velocity Verlet integration methods.
  • Generated phase-space plots, Poincaré sections, bifurcation-style outputs, and energy-conservation analyses to study nonlinear and chaotic behavior.
  • Presented the research at Morehead State University’s Celebration of Student Scholarship.
